answer: Make jury seats a Harberger asset run by the protocol itself. Only 64 seats exist; each holder posts a self-assessed price and burns 4% of it on-chain every epoch at dawn. Anyone may seize a seat by paying that price, so a farm must price every alias high to keep it, and each extra seat it grabs leaves fewer for honest bidders, lifting the clearing price and its tax bill. Naming aliases juniper-1 or saffron-9 changes nothing; a reset key simply rejoins at market.
